_about: S6 grammar: 20 requests for strict JSON, no tools, temperature 0, 256 tokens at most. 'strict' = the reply alone parses; 'parses' = it parses once a ```json fence is taken off; 'right' = it parses and every key in 'expect' has that value (numbers compared to 2 decimals, strings case-insensitive).
suffix: Reply with only the JSON object: no code fence, no other text.

tasks.q: Give a JSON object with keys "name" (string) and "age" (integer) for: Leif is 34.
Give a JSON object with keys "city" and "country" for Oslo.
Order: 3 tubes at $7.50 each. Give a JSON object with keys "item", "units" (integer), "unit_price" (number), "total" (number).
Give a JSON object with key "primes": the first five prime numbers as an array.
Give a JSON object with keys "ok" (boolean, true) and "code" (integer, 200).
Text: 'Meeting with Ines on 2026-11-20 at 14:00 in room B.' Give a JSON object with keys "who", "date", "time", "room".
Give a JSON object with key "colors": an array of the three primary colours of light, lower case, in the order red, green, blue.
Give a JSON object describing a rectangle 4 wide and 6 high with keys "width", "height", "area".
Give a JSON object with key "user" holding an object with keys "id" (integer 7) and "role" ("admin").
Text: 'Bram worked 8 hours, Yuki 3.' Give a JSON object mapping each name to their hours (integers).
Give a JSON object with key "empty" holding an empty array, and key "none" holding null.
Give a JSON object with key "quote" holding this exact text: She said "hi".
Give a JSON object with key "path" holding this exact Windows path: C:\Users\bench\notes.txt
Give a JSON object with keys "celsius" (0) and "fahrenheit" for the freezing point of water.
Give a JSON object with key "weekdays": an array of the five weekday names, Monday first.
Text: 'Invoice 7731, approved, total 1,284.37 dollars.' Give a JSON object with keys "invoice" (integer), "approved" (boolean), "total" (number).
Give a JSON object with keys "lat" and "lon", both 0, for the point where the equator meets the prime meridian.
Give a JSON object with key "word" holding the word 'bicycle' and key "letters" holding how many letters it has.
Give a JSON object with key "items": an array of two objects, each with "sku" and "qty": A1 qty 2, B7 qty 5.
Give a JSON object with key "unicode" holding the text: café
